properties.name: app.log-service-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Lambda-backed log API used for audit logging

properties.name: app.jwt.hmac-secret
properties.description: HMAC secret for JWT token signing and validation

properties.name: app.jwt.auth-mode
properties.description: Authentication token validation mode. Supported values: local, hybrid, cognito.

properties.name: app.jwt.cognito.issuer
properties.description: Expected Cognito issuer URL for RS256 token validation.

properties.name: app.jwt.cognito.audience
properties.description: Expected Cognito app client ID used as token audience/client_id.

properties.name: app.jwt.cognito.jwks-url
properties.description: Cognito JWKS endpoint URL used to resolve RSA verification keys.

properties.name: app.jwt.cognito.jwks-cache-ttl-seconds
properties.description: JWKS cache TTL in seconds for Cognito key refresh.

properties.name: app.verification-email.provider
properties.description: Verification email provider. Supported values: mock, ses.

properties.name: app.verification-email.sender-email
properties.description: Sender email address for SES verification emails.

properties.name: app.verification-email.aws-region
properties.description: Optional AWS region override for SES client.

properties.name: app.verification-email.aws-endpoint-url
properties.description: Optional AWS endpoint override for SES client (for example LocalStack).

properties.name: app.verification-email.dispatch.enabled
properties.description: Enable scheduled dispatch worker for queued verification communications.

properties.name: app.verification-email.dispatch.poll-interval-ms
properties.description: Dispatch worker poll interval in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.verification-email.dispatch.max-batch-size
properties.description: Maximum queued communications to process per worker poll.

properties.name: app.verification-email.dispatch.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum dispatch attempts before marking communication failed.

properties.name: app.verification-email.dispatch.base-backoff-seconds
properties.description: Base exponential backoff in seconds for queued retries.

properties.name: app.verification-email.dispatch.service-token-ttl-seconds
properties.description: TTL in seconds for internally minted JWT used by dispatch worker.

properties.name: app.verification-email.dispatch.service-user-id
properties.description: Subject claim for internally minted dispatch worker JWT.
